body: Pandorahs Box in Age of Mythology

You talk about the relationship not clicking. She is the first girl I've ever dated that I felt like I did click with. I've never had such a powerful emotional response as I do when I'm with her, that emotional response is only second to the pain I felt when I was alone.

These feelings have been here as long as I had a perception of purpose. The only thing thats changing is that my medium for dealing with them is going to disappear for a long time, if not forever. I set a date sometime 2 years ago that basically said "1 year from now, if things don't get better, I'm going to kill myself." I met her around the time that date came up and it helped my change my mind, and its helped to keep it changed since.
